source_units.text: Solomon came to Aimath Soba and prevailed over it.
source_units.display_text: Solomon came to Aimath Soba and prevailed over it.

source_units.text: All Judah stood before the Lord, with their children and the women.
source_units.display_text: All Judah stood before the Lord, with their children and the women.

source_units.text: Tomorrow go down against them. Behold, they are coming up by the ascent of Asas. You will find them at the edge of the river of the wilderness of Jeriel.
source_units.display_text: Tomorrow go down against them. Behold, they are coming up by the ascent of Asas. You will find them at the edge of the river of the wilderness of Jeriel.

source_units.text: Jehoiada took two wives for him, and he begot sons and daughters.
source_units.display_text: Jehoiada took two wives for him, and he begot sons and daughters.

source_units.text: He built towers in the wilderness and hewed many cisterns, because he had many herds in Sephela and the plain, and vinedressers in the hill country and Carmel, for he loved farming.
source_units.display_text: He built towers in the wilderness and hewed many cisterns, because he had many herds in Sephela and the plain, and vinedressers in the hill country and Carmel, for he loved farming.

source_units.text: Uzziah had forces that waged war and went out to battle array by number. Their number was recorded by Iiel the scribe and Maasaias the judge under Ananias, the king’s deputy.
source_units.display_text: Uzziah had forces that waged war and went out to battle array by number. Their number was recorded by Iiel the scribe and Maasaias the judge under Ananias, the king’s deputy.

source_units.text: The total number of ancestral rulers mighty for war was two thousand six hundred.
source_units.display_text: The total number of ancestral rulers mighty for war was two thousand six hundred.

source_units.text: With them was a fighting force of three hundred seven thousand five hundred, waging war with mighty strength to help the king against his adversaries.
source_units.display_text: With them was a fighting force of three hundred seven thousand five hundred, waging war with mighty strength to help the king against his adversaries.

source_units.text: Uzziah prepared for them, for the whole force, large shields, spears, helmets, breastplates, bows, and slings for stones.
source_units.display_text: Uzziah prepared for them, for the whole force, large shields, spears, helmets, breastplates, bows, and slings for stones.

source_units.text: He fought the king of the sons of Ammon and prevailed over him. The sons of Ammon gave him yearly one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand kors of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. The king of Ammon brought him these each year, in the first, second, and third years.
source_units.display_text: He fought the king of the sons of Ammon and prevailed over him. The sons of Ammon gave him yearly one hundred talents of silver, ten thousand kors of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. The king of Ammon brought him these each year, in the first, second, and third years.

source_units.text: Ezekri, the mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maasaias the king’s son, Esdrikam the ruler of his house, and Elkana, the king’s deputy.
source_units.display_text: Ezekri, the mighty man of Ephraim, killed Maasaias the king’s son, Esdrikam the ruler of his house, and Elkana, the king’s deputy.

source_units.text: King Hezekiah rose early, gathered the city’s rulers, and went up to the Lord’s house.
source_units.display_text: King Hezekiah rose early, gathered the city’s rulers, and went up to the Lord’s house.

source_units.text: The consecrated animals were six hundred calves and three thousand sheep.
source_units.display_text: The consecrated animals were six hundred calves and three thousand sheep.

source_units.text: In the third month the heaps began to be laid, and in the seventh month they were completed.
source_units.display_text: In the third month the heaps began to be laid, and in the seventh month they were completed.

source_units.text: Iiel, Ozazias, Naeth, Asael, Jerimoth, Jozabath, Eliel, Samachia, Maath, Banaias, and his sons were appointed through Chonenias and his brother Semei, as King Hezekiah and Azarias, the leader of the Lord’s house, commanded.
source_units.display_text: Iiel, Ozazias, Naeth, Asael, Jerimoth, Jozabath, Eliel, Samachia, Maath, Banaias, and his sons were appointed through Chonenias and his brother Semei, as King Hezekiah and Azarias, the leader of the Lord’s house, commanded.

source_units.text: apart from the male offspring from three years old and upward, for everyone entering the Lord’s house for the daily account, for ministry in their appointed divisions.
source_units.display_text: apart from the male offspring from three years old and upward, for everyone entering the Lord’s house for the daily account, for ministry in their appointed divisions.

source_units.text: Many brought gifts to the Lord at Jerusalem and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah, and afterward he was highly exalted in the eyes of all the nations.
source_units.display_text: Many brought gifts to the Lord at Jerusalem and presents to Hezekiah king of Judah, and afterward he was highly exalted in the eyes of all the nations.

source_units.text: and cities for the produce of grain, oil, and wine, mangers for every animal, and folds for the flocks,
source_units.display_text: and cities for the produce of grain, oil, and wine, mangers for every animal, and folds for the flocks,

source_units.text: After these things he built a wall outside the City of David, from the southwest opposite Gihon in the winter stream, and where people go out through the surrounding gate, and toward Ophla, and raised it very high. He stationed commanders of the force in all Judah’s walled cities.

General conquest language alone is insufficient.
